title: Persona input fixture (v5.3)
description: One persona of 13 or 14: the generator input at day 0, plus how the runner behaves afterwards and scripted events. INPUTS ONLY: expected outputs belong to the oracle (B-5). Every value carries its provenance: a 'spec' value cites the line of 13/14 it comes from; an 'invented' value was chosen in v5.2 to complete the persona and must be reviewed (gap/oracle.md §7).

persona.description: Name and one-line description as in 13/14.

sources.description: 13/14 sections and test ids this fixture serves, e.g. '13 §3', 'TST-110'.

release.description: Release profile that the goal needs (12 §6).

behaviour.description: How the runner logs after day 0. The oracle and the integration harness simulate the log week by week from it; the generator itself never reads this block.

model.description: as_planned: every planned session is ticked 'done as planned' on its date (entered the same evening, source tick), RPE = the target RPE of its effort (ses.target_rpe), pain tap answered No, next-morning prompt answered No, GI 0 and intake = the planned fuelling target on practice runs, level tests answered yes/yes/no pain. day0_only: only the day-0 call is in scope. scripted: as_planned except the listed deviations.

replan.description: weekly: the harness calls the generator every Monday with the log so far (13's tables show the week as published at its Monday).

horizon_weeks.description: How many weeks to simulate (null = to race week + transition).

provenance.description: JSON-pointer-like paths into 'input' (e.g. 'profile.birth_year', 'claim.L30_duration_s') → 'spec: <source line>' or 'invented: <reason>'. Every leaf value that is not an empty list or a structural default must appear.
